text:
### FCA Reporting Requirement (COBS)  
**Who Files:** FirstUK Bank (directly to FCA)
**When:** As data to FCA, not automatically disclosed
**What:** Aggregated complaint statistics (quarterly)
**Disclosure:** Customers can escalate to FCA if unresolved after 8 weeks
name: Chunk 23/36

raw_entities.name: FCA Reporting Requirement
raw_entities.description: Policy governing FirstUK Bank's obligation to file aggregated complaint statistics to the FCA on a quarterly basis. The policy establishes the reporting cadence, data scope, and disclosure framework for complaints handling under COBS rules.
context: FCA Reporting Requirement (COBS)
As data to FCA, not automatically disclosed
Aggregated complaint statistics (quarterly)

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Aggregated Complaint Statistics Filing
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement for FirstUK Bank to submit aggregated complaint statistics to the FCA on a quarterly basis. This is a discrete reporting obligation distinct from individual complaint handling.
context: Aggregated complaint statistics (quarterly)
As data to FCA, not automatically disclosed

raw_entities.name: Customer Escalation Right to FCA After Eight Weeks
raw_entities.description: Provision allowing customers to escalate unresolved complaints to the FCA after eight weeks of non-resolution by FirstUK Bank. This establishes the customer's right to external regulatory escalation.
context: Customers can escalate to FCA if unresolved after 8 weeks

raw_entities.name: Conduct of Business Sourcebook
raw_entities.description: FCA regulatory rulebook governing conduct of business requirements, including complaints handling and reporting obligations. COBS establishes the framework under which FirstUK Bank must report complaint statistics and manage customer escalations.
context: FCA Reporting Requirement (COBS)

raw_entities.name: Complaints Handling Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that FirstUK Bank fails to properly handle, track, or report customer complaints in accordance with FCA COBS requirements, resulting in regulatory breach or customer detriment.
context: FCA Reporting Requirement (COBS)
Customers can escalate to FCA if unresolved after 8 weeks

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Bank
raw_entities.description: The regulated entity responsible for filing aggregated complaint statistics to the FCA on a quarterly basis and managing the complaints escalation process in accordance with COBS.
context: FirstUK Bank (directly to FCA)
